boundaries: Deleted registrations have no restorable snapshots. Financial records retain independent access.
Remote connector revocation remains a manually completed todo. Remote OJ live provisioning was not rerun in this task.
Rollback after permanent cleanup requires the pre-upgrade database and file backup.

focusedBrowserScenarios: administrators edit and save other peoples entries without participant submission actions
completed reviews use amendment actions and require a new decision and reason
finance applications belong to applicants while administrators process the applications
finance-only administrators can issue invoices without registration file-management permissions
personal activity tabs never inherit administrator list scope
view-only management grants do not expose applicant actions or contest credentials
saved profile and settings require Edit; Cancel restores the saved values
review opens a read-only information dialog and separates correction, editing and approval
coach field drafts cancel cleanly and save with the rest of the registration
version conflicts preserve draft fields until the user explicitly cancels
multiple rooms preview allocations before commit and saved configuration stays read-only
new generic activities default to optional modules off and narrow screens remain usable
roleWorkflowFollowUp.rootCause: Management editing was reused for applicant submission and financial requests; completed and pending reviews shared the same actions; invoice dialogs retained attachment state across requests.
fixes: Administrator editing does not grant applicant submission, withdrawal or financial applications; own registrations and linked coach operations remain available.
Only pending unpaid submissions can be withdrawn; reviewed registrations use editing, resubmission or cancellation.
Initial reviews and amendments have separate actions, options, required reasons and queue behavior; unsubmitted changes cannot be reviewed.
Applicant requests and finance processing have separate permissions, including after registration removal.
FINANCE administrators can upload actual invoices without FILES or REGISTRATIONS management grants.
Invoice dialogs start with independent empty attachments; successful voucher submission resets the new-request form; failures retain the current draft.
Personal contest registration and admission tabs explicitly request role=mine.
Credential buttons match participant association, activity modules and INTEGRATIONS rights.
Unreleased admission downloads require ADMISSIONS rights rather than VIEW.
Draft status and individual-entry labels no longer imply pending review or team captain status.
Room-managed admission generation uses committed seating rather than asking for a separate legacy room.
Reversed payments show completion and do not offer duplicate reversal, including filtered ledger pages.
